overview.title: Small steps count here
overview.intro: Points recognize effort, consistency, improvement, and finishing meaningful work. They have no cash or purchase value.

progress.label: Your path
progress.title: Build your next learning habit
progress.body: Progress is personal: return to your goals, notice what changed, and take the next useful step.

streaks.title: Streaks with room to breathe
streaks.body: Approved illness and travel absences protect a streak. Taking care of yourself never counts against you.

badges.title: Badges for real learning
badges.body: Badges celebrate asking, improving, helping, and completing—not just getting the highest score.

challenges.title: Seasonal challenges
challenges.body: Choose a short, meaningful challenge when it fits your learning plan. You can opt in; there is no endless feed.

community.title: Seasonal community challenge
community.body: This parent-enabled space lets you take part in a shared seasonal activity. Your progress stays personal; no child leaderboard is shown.

overview.privacy: There are no global public leaderboards for children. A parent can turn off optional competition for this learner at any time.
